hygStarPanel.estimatedNote: Effective temperature, radius and mass are modelled from the spectral class and absolute magnitude, not measured for this star. Luminosity is the catalog absolute magnitude restated in solar units, in visible light only. Catalog:

fidelityBadge.toggleHint: What in this view is adjusted, and what is measured
fidelityBadge.didacticDesc: Sizes and gaps are exaggerated so everything fits one view.
fidelityBadge.brightnessRealDesc: Sunlight falls off with real distance, uncorrected — the outer worlds are genuinely this dark.
fidelityBadge.brightnessAssistedDesc: Real distances, range compressed so distant worlds stay visible. Order of brightness is preserved.
fidelityBadge.brightnessEqualizedDesc: Every world lit as if it sat at Earth's distance — distance tells you nothing here.
